_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.

Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.22x; +17% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.95; conservative 2yr +71%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY12-FY12 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +37.0%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.2-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +37.0%/yr (no FY12-FY12 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +37.0%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY12-FY12: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2013-03-28) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.22x (17.3% downside to Bear $32 / +78.4% upside to Bull $69) | Adj composite 2.55 vs market 1.60: gap +0.95 [UNDERVALUED] | +17% above the EPP floor $33 (59x FY13E $0.56) | Conservative 2-yr case: +71.4% total (+35.7%/yr) | At 69.1x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $51 sits at or below the BASE case; segment EBDA n/r and Natural Gas Pipelines n/r in Q4 2012, forward revenues +59% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
